Owen hopes to visit Toronto one day. The night market is one of the best places in the city. There are always many people at the train station. Also, check the travel advisory before booking.
Owen wants to be a teacher in the future. The weather was snowy that day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the night market by bike. The hovercraft skims the wetlands.
Last Tuesday, Owen and Eva went to the night market. Owen and Eva had great fun there. Eva is interested in drawing. Best of all, the museum sits on Fifth Avenue.
Life is full of small surprises. Eva's birthday is in November. Owen bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday.
